title: Drybox Humidity Alert by Filament
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=filament:spool
| stats avg(drybox_humidity_pct) as drybox_humidity_pct by material color
| where drybox_humidity_pct>20
| sort - drybox_humidity_pct
description: Uses Filament drybox sensors telemetry to monitor storage humidity by filament material and color in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for spools that are likely to print worse because they are too damp, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Filament drybox sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds storage humidity by filament material and color so you can spot spools that are likely to print worse because they are too damp before it becomes annoying.
